title: Logozusatz / Horizontal left aligned

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Anchor a business lockup to the reading edge so a viewer can connect the sender and descriptor in a wider composition.
strategic_value: A consistent left alignment can connect DB masterbrand recognition to accompanying content.
demonstration: The red DB logo appears at left, followed by the black Zusatz descriptor in a horizontal lockup.
practical_value: Use the left-aligned example to evaluate how the lockup relates to a neighboring text column.

content_islands.name: Aligned lockup
content_islands.spec: Place the mark at the left and reveal the descriptor beside it.

content_islands.name: Business descriptor
content_islands.spec: Keep the black Zusatz text subordinate to the DB mark and reveal it after the mark.

reference_purposes.Application: The source presents this arrangement as a business/product suffix variant.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The accompanying text permits the suffix when communication relates exclusively to a particular business or product area.
